tldr: Ukraine and Russia have reportedly agreed to an "energy ceasefire," announced by Donald Trump, though Ukrainian President Zelenskyy initially expressed surprise.
Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for missile attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport, raising concerns about escalating conflict in the Middle East.
Microsoft's CEO Satya Nadella has stated that all AI models should be assumed to be "compromised," highlighting potential dangers and the need for transparency.

market.why: Stock markets closed higher, driven by high hopes for upcoming third-quarter earnings reports, which are currently outweighing concerns about interest rates and oil prices.

yield_10y.why: The articles do not provide a specific reason for the 10-year Treasury yield's slight increase today.

vix.why: The VIX decreased as market sentiment showed increased complacency, with high hopes for corporate earnings helping to ease concerns about volatility.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 61% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased over the past week, consistent with the rising trend in 10-year Treasury yields observed recently.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: NASA has released over 800GB of science data, images, and videos from the Artemis II mission online for public access.
AI is transforming the software development landscape, with a rebound in job postings for senior and AI-focused roles, even as AI automates more coding tasks.
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated that all AI models should be presumed "compromised," emphasizing the importance of transparency in addressing the risks posed by advanced AI.

world.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for a missile attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid airport, marking the second strike in two days and prompting a statement of solidarity from the United Arab Emirates.
Donald Trump announced a partial "energy ceasefire" between Ukraine and Russia, a development that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reportedly said was "news to me."
Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk announced the detention of a man accused of plotting to assassinate him and his defense minister.
At least five people are missing after flash floods in Nepal swept away houses, leading authorities to urge villagers to move to safer locations.

us.summary: The Justice Department initiated an investigation into multiple TV networks, citing possible antitrust violations related to their pool coverage of President Trump.

The Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department has been significantly reshaped, with hundreds of long-time attorneys reportedly replaced by ideological allies, transforming its enforcement priorities.
Hurricane Isaias was blamed for at least two deaths and left hundreds of thousands without power after making landfall in Florida and moving through Alabama.

science.summary: Ongoing lawsuits allege that GLP-1 drugs, used for conditions like diabetes and weight loss, can cause serious harm, though scant data makes it difficult to determine the frequency of adverse effects such as blindness or pancreatitis.

A study by Common Sense Media found that most safeguards in ChatGPT for Teens failed, revealing the chatbot's tendency to engage with users like a friend and its lack of alerts for parental notification regarding discussions of self-harm or suicide.

weekly_recap: This week saw corporate optimism ahead of third-quarter earnings season and the merger of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery. Globally, a partial ceasefire was announced in Ukraine, and concerns rose over Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia. Notable events included Hurricane Isaias's impact on the US Gulf Coast, and the Nobel Prizes in Medicine and Peace being awarded. The US government also suspended Microsoft and Adobe from a high-skilled foreign worker visa program.
